name: Capvision

overview:
Capvision provides expert consultations, surveys, conference calls, and customized research for financial institutions, consulting firms, and enterprises. The company describes a network of more than 600,000 experts and lists Malaysia, Austin, and Shanghai as headquarters locations. These are company disclosures, not independently audited measures of current scale.

Current public materials also use the ChatBrilliant name. Capvision Malaysia describes itself as the Southeast Asia hub of ChatBrilliant Partners and markets an AI-driven ChatBrilliant Content Library. Keboda’s 2025 annual report, published in April 2026, identifies 慧谈智能科技（上海）股份有限公司 as the renamed 凯盛融英信息科技（上海）股份有限公司. These disclosures establish a naming development but do not by themselves explain the ownership or contracting arrangements across all Capvision-branded businesses.

history.narrative: Capvision’s About page states that it was founded in 2006 by former management consultants and investment bankers; its LinkedIn page names Bain & Company and Morgan Stanley as their former firms. The official website’s homepage instead displays an establishment year of 2008. The discrepancy is unresolved. In 2026, public corporate reporting identifies a new name for the Shanghai entity, while current Capvision Malaysia materials describe a relationship with ChatBrilliant Partners.

timeline.event: Founding year stated on Capvision’s About and LinkedIn pages; the website homepage separately displays 2008.
China’s foreign ministry acknowledged national security law enforcement action when asked about the investigation into Capvision.
Keboda’s annual report identifies 慧谈智能科技（上海）股份有限公司 as formerly 凯盛融英信息科技（上海）股份有限公司; it does not give the effective date of the name change.
Capvision Malaysia’s public company page identifies it as ChatBrilliant Partners’ Southeast Asia hub and describes an AI-driven ChatBrilliant Content Library; no launch date is given.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Consultations
servicesDetailed.description: Capvision offers one-on-one telephone and in-person consultations with selected industry experts. Live language translation is available on request.

servicesDetailed.name: Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: The company offers quantitative and qualitative surveys, with support from questionnaire design through reporting or for individual stages.

servicesDetailed.name: Industry Research
servicesDetailed.description: Capvision describes research teams combining internal analysts and external experts for industry research, market research, corporate consulting, and due diligence.

servicesDetailed.name: Conferences
servicesDetailed.description: Expert-led conferences and conference calls cover policy developments, investment opportunities, and industry topics.

aiPlatform.narrative: Capvision describes a proprietary CRM. Capvision Malaysia separately says it combines CRM technology with an AI-driven ChatBrilliant Content Library for access to interviews, surveys, transcripts, and tailored research. This is company-stated functionality; the sources reviewed do not document AI matching, automated compliance checks, natural language search, or the previously listed third-party integrations.
features: AI-driven ChatBrilliant Content Library (company-stated by Capvision Malaysia)

complianceExtended.narrative: Capvision’s expert page says it handles compliance, scheduling, and payments for experts. The reviewed materials do not establish current MNPI controls, regional compliance staffing, or client audit-trail functionality.
complianceExtended.regulatoryContext: At its May 9, 2023 press conference, China’s foreign ministry responded to questions naming Capvision by acknowledging joint law enforcement action by national security authorities and other departments. This documents the historical action; it does not establish the company’s current compliance status.

clientFit.narrative: Editorial assessment: the documented consultations, surveys, and customized research make Capvision relevant to investment, consulting, and corporate research teams. Buyers considering ChatBrilliant-branded services should clarify the contracting entity and product access.

strengths: Consultations with translation available on request
Survey support from questionnaire design through reporting
Research teams combining internal analysts and external experts
caveats: Company sources disagree on founding year and headquarters presentation.
Expert and employee totals are self-reported and undated.
The reviewed sources do not disclose buyer pricing or establish current audit-trail and MNPI controls.
The relationship among Capvision-branded operations and ChatBrilliant requires clarification before contracting.
notableFacts: Capvision Malaysia currently describes itself as ChatBrilliant Partners’ Southeast Asia hub.
A corporate annual report published in April 2026 records the Shanghai entity’s new Chinese name.
